positions.name: MissingIdHandlingContract
positions.frame: what must hold when a markdown heading arrives without an id field?
positions.why: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern — a ## heading with no id field — and src-2 states the behavioral requirement: no crash, valid slug output. Together they cohere around the question of what correct handling looks like for the missing-id case, holding both the reproduction of the failure and the contract that must be met.
